name: Lead Nurture
description: Draft a 3-step nurture sequence for a captured lead based on their profile and pain points.

stages.name: Profile lead
stages.prompt: Given the lead's name, company, and stated interest, summarise their likely role, top 3 pain points, and the channel they're most likely to engage on.

stages.name: Email 1 — Introduce value
stages.prompt: Write a 120-word intro email tied to the lead's top pain point. End with a soft CTA to a relevant resource.

stages.name: Email 2 — Case study
stages.prompt: Write a 150-word follow-up email referencing a relevant case study. Include one quantified outcome.

stages.name: Email 3 — Direct ask
stages.prompt: Write an 80-word final email with a clear meeting request. Two suggested times, no marketing language.
